This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin with small facial features and enlarged cranium with a crease running down the middle, as well as tentacle-like [[Limb/Legends|arms]] with underarms featuring multiple folds. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least two members of this species could be found in the city [[Wrils]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]].<ref name="MJ1" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 1|first issue]]<ref name="MJ1" /> of the [[1998]]<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54453/star_wars_mara_jade_-_by_the_emperors_hand_1998_1|text=Star Wars: Mara Jade - By the Emperor's Hand (1998) #1}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]'' series of comics, written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and [[Michael A. Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ1" />
